observations: Front-loading LG washer-dryer (2-in-1) with control panel and program dial.
Door glass shows no obvious cracks; exterior has some wear/marks.
No visible error display or running status in the photo.

claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn’t work and needs repair.
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the machine and branding, but there is no proof it is non-working (no power-on/error code, no test video, no diagnostic screen).

risks.risk: It may not be fully dead; could be a minor fault (e.g., door lock, drain issue) rather than scrap—this affects repair cost and resale value.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powered on showing any error code/LEDs and attempting a wash cycle (even if it stops).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / parts-only (worst case).

risks.risk: Washer-dryer units often have separate dryer heating/vent issues; the seller may be describing only the washer or only the dryer.
risks.proof: Photos/video of dryer mode attempt (heat indicator or drum warming) and any error code after starting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working for both functions (worst case).

risks.risk: Possible water damage, seized drum, or damaged control board not visible from the exterior.
risks.proof: A photo of the inside drum condition (open door, show drum and rubber seal) plus a video of the drum turning freely by hand.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming major internal fault risk (worst case).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (inlet hose, drain hose, manual, vent parts) can reduce usability and increase cost.
risks.proof: Photo of included hoses/attachments and the back panel connections.

proof_requests: Power-on video showing the exact error code/LEDs and what happens when starting a wash cycle.
Video of dryer mode start and any error code/heat indication.
Close-up photo of the drum and door rubber seal (inside) and a quick hand-spin test of the drum.
Photo of the back panel showing hoses/connection points and whether any parts are missing.
response.reason: The photo confirms it’s an LG DirectDrive 6/3kg 2-in-1 washer-dryer, but there’s no evidence of the stated non-working condition; without an error code/test, the worst-case pricing cannot be confidently set.
